title: SikaBook SaleEvent
description: Contract between the on-device model pipeline (ASR + NLU) and the ghana-voice-ledger app. Field names and semantics mirror the Room entity Transaction (data/local/entity/Transaction.kt). Every consumer and producer of sale events MUST validate against this schema.

schema_version.description: Bump on breaking changes. Consumers must reject versions they don't understand.

event_id.description: UUID for this event. Becomes Room Transaction.id.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the sale utterance ended (not when processed). Becomes Transaction.timestamp; Transaction.date is derived as YYYY-MM-DD local.

is_sale.description: NLU decision that a completed sale occurred in this utterance. false events are logged for QA only, never written to Room.

amount.description: Sale total in GHS. Pesewas must be converted (e.g. 'fifty pesewas' -> 0.50). Mirrors Transaction.amount/finalPrice.

product.description: Canonical product name from the product vocabulary (data/nlu/product_vocabulary.json), not the raw surface form. Mirrors Transaction.product.

product_surface.description: The raw form heard in speech, before canonicalization (e.g. 'apateshi' when product='Tilapia').

quantity.description: Number of items. Null when not detectable. Mirrors Transaction.quantity.

unit.description: Normalized measurement unit: piece|bowl|bucket|tin|can|size|pack|bag|sachet|dozen|crate|gallon. Ghanaian surface forms canonicalize: 'kokoo'->bowl, 'rubber'->bucket. Mirrors Transaction.unit.

unit_price.description: Per-item price when quantity is present and 'each'/'per' semantics were heard. Informational; the sale total is amount.

original_price.description: Price quoted before negotiation/discount, when both are heard. Mirrors Transaction.originalPrice.

language.description: Dominant language of the utterance as decided by ASR/LID. Mirrors SpeakerProfile.preferredLanguage conventions.

transcript.description: ASR transcript of the utterance. Mirrors Transaction.transcriptSnippet.

speaker_role_confidence.description: Confidence that the speaker of the utterance is the seller. Mirrors Transaction.sellerConfidence.

needs_review.description: True when confidence < thresholds or validation issues exist. Mirrors Transaction.needsReview.

validation_issues.description: Human-readable reasons the event was flagged (e.g. 'amount below product min price').

utterance_start_ms.description: Audio stream offset of utterance start, for debugging/replay.

extractor.description: Which stage produced the event: 'rules' | 'bert' | 'llm'. For routing metrics in eval.
